title: Enforce a host allow-list on MongoDB MCP connection strings
description: In the same mongodb-mcp-server checkout, validate the connection string accepted by the connect tool (src/tools/mongodb/connect/connect.ts:14) and switch-connection (src/tools/mongodb/connect/switch-connection.ts:13-20) before it reaches session.connectToMongoDB (src/common/session.ts:148) and MCPConnectionManager.connect: accept only mongodb:// and mongodb+srv:// schemes and only hosts present on an environment-configured allow-list (default deny, governed egress), and keep connect-type tools disabled in readOnly deployments unless explicitly enabled in deployment config. No egress class or allow-list exists anywhere in the server today, which is what lets a hijacked or prompt-injected agent redirect sessions to an attacker-chosen host. Unit-test scheme rejection, host rejection and readOnly behaviour. Roll out dev, then qa, then prod per sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess with one approval.
acceptanceCriteria: A vitest case asserts that connect and switch-connection return a tool error instead of opening a session when the connection string scheme is not mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// or when its host is not on the configured allow-list
A vitest case asserts that in readOnly mode connect and switch-connection are disabled unless the deployment config explicitly enables them
The allow-list is configuration-driven: dev, qa and prod deployment configs each declare a non-empty approved host list, verified by a test that loads each config
Re-running probe-agent-graph on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server returns no AGENT-ASI03-03 result for src/tools/mongodb/connect/connect.ts

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-agent-graph on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server and read the SARIF export; expected result: the AGENT-ASI03-03 result for src/tools/mongodb/connect/connect.ts no longer fires at the new pinned commit because connection strings are validated against a host allow-list before reaching the driver

rootCause.description: connect.ts and switch-connection.ts (first-party code at commit aaa72a0) pass a model-controlled z.string() connection string straight to the MongoDB driver with no host allow-list, no scheme enforcement and no declared egress class, and connect-type tools stay enabled in readOnly mode
